name: Data Access Security Campaign Reminder
description: Sent to reviewers who still have outstanding items in an in-progress Data Access Security certification campaign, on the reminder schedule an administrator configures for it.
subject: Reminder: An access certification task awaits your review — final due date: $campaignReminder.dueDate
body:
Access Certification Reminder

Hi,

An access certification task is awaiting your review. Please complete your review by $campaignReminder.dueDate.

Follow the link to view the task.

Additional task details

  • Campaign name: $campaignReminder.name
  • Description: $campaignReminder.description
  • Instructions: $campaignReminder.instructions

Thank you for your attention to this Data Access Security request.
